facts.text: Quadrotor constructs its node name as "robot_" + to_string(robot_id) and computes dt = 1.0 / frequency.
The constructor logs dt and creates a wall timer with period dt that runs iteration.

The constructor creates one subscription to a per-robot desired_state topic of type geometry_msgs::msg::Point with queue size 10; the adjacent comment names /mavswarm2/robot_3/desired_state as the example.

desired_pos_cb converts the received Point to (x, y, z), returns without action when the new target is within 0.2 m of target_pos, otherwise stores it and calls scp_planner_->set_goal(p1, ss.position, ss.velocity).
The comment above desired_pos_cb names the goal handoff as the NED frame.
publish_words.py states that goals are in the controller's NED frame (x North, y East, z Down; negative z is up).
publish_words.py imports geometry_msgs.msg.Point.
publish_words.py creates one Point publisher per robot on /mavswarm2/robot_{i}/desired_state with queue size 10.
The helper's assignment log reports the total distance in metres.
The constructor creates a visualization_msgs::msg::Marker publisher on the per-robot trajectory topic with queue size 10; the adjacent comment names /mavswarm2/robot_3/trajectory as the example.
The trajectory marker is a LINE_STRIP in frame map with namespace trajectory, id robot_id and action ADD.
publish_path samples every fifth timer tick, appends state_space.position (NWU/map frame) to the marker points, keeps at most 200 points, and publishes the marker.
set_state_space converts the internal NED state to the map frame with ned_nwu_rotation before broadcasting.
The constructor creates a tf2_ros::TransformBroadcaster, sets the world frame to map and the child frame to robot_<id>/base_link.
main spins the Quadrotor node and calls rclcpp::shutdown() after spin returns.
The launch file starts the mavswarm2 executable as node robot_3 in namespace mavswarm2.
The launch's controller_frequency argument defaults to 100.
The README documents colcon build and ros2 launch mavswarm2 quadrotor.launch.
package.xml declares ament_cmake and the rclcpp, simulator_interfaces, std_msgs, geometry_msgs, sensor_msgs, visualization_msgs, tf2 and tf2_ros dependencies.
CMakeLists.txt builds the mavswarm2 executable from src/quadrotor.cpp, links GSL and glog, and installs the launch, config and cf_description directories.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies with no SCP planner, controller, GSL dynamics, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay; the fake is not a recording of captured traffic

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS contract fake (canned replies; no Mavswarm2 node or physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport: it answers the declared trajectory subscription with a placeholder Marker and records publications to the desired_state topic; it runs no mavswarm2 node, SCP planner, geometric controller, GSL dynamics, TF broadcaster or RViz
the marker points are placeholder constants and do not advance; a live run must receive the node's own /mavswarm2/robot_3/trajectory samples
the desired_state publication is recorded only; the fake does not plan, fly or apply a goal and cannot claim that the simulated vehicle moved

the last_goal resource observation echoes the last recorded publication; in a live deployment the command topic is volatile, so a fresh subscription receives a message only when one is published while it waits and the read is not a replay of the last goal

because of that, in a live graph every command waits the 2 s last_goal read timeout and mhs.resource.read fails MHS.DEVICE.NOT_READY unless a goal is published meanwhile (model review probe with the topic silent); the fake answers the subscription at once with a placeholder or the last recorded goal
the clone registers no control, reset or stop service/action; the package declares no safety binding and the stock e-stop reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED
TF, SCP path, the other robots, parameter services, sensors, camera, RViz, world step, reset, snapshot and restore are NOT COVERED
the upstream depends on the external simulator_interfaces package and GSL/Eigen; the clone was not built, launched or connected to a live ROS graph

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop exists in the pinned clone: the only control input is the desired_state Point publication, and the node creates no service or action and reports no measured quiescence. The stock e-stop can only latch this driver's publications and reports that the simulated vehicle's safe state was not reached; an operator must stop the ROS process or publish a hover goal outside the latched driver path.
